trace: Every call is owned when it is sent, by the step open at that moment: page reads and tool discovery, page writes and previews, forced calls, second Agent reads and writes, Infra events, clock moves, the seed load and the inspector's own snapshot reads. A step opens when the previous one is sealed or its sequence begins, and its action runs inside it. The page load before the first sequence is owned by the setup, which may make only unlisted reads and is not listed here; the two pieces of work between sequences are owned separately and are the two entries of between_sequences. A call sent with no owner stops the script, and a reply never changes ownership. A step is frozen before anything is taken from it: the recorder reads the version, runs the check, waits until nothing the step owns is outstanding and reads the App's state, and stops if the version changed since before the check; observations, version and virtual time come from that frozen state, the wait and scrolling before the screenshot come after it, and a call sent after the freeze stops the script and cannot count toward submits. Each call has exactly one terminal outcome, the reply or a failure with its HTTP status and error; a failure or a second outcome stops the script. A forced call carries a header token bound to the exact tool and arguments it was issued for; a token sent with any other call stops the script. Recorder errors are append-only, so a stop that a caller catches is still reported at teardown. Listed: page writes and previews with their raw arguments and raw reply (HTTP status and JSON body), unshortened; second Agent writes, Infra events, clock moves and forced calls raw, except the host wall-clock fields received_at and processed_at in Infra event receipts, replaced by a note so repeated captures are identical; second Agent reads summarized to the fields the step checks; the seed load by its file names. Page reads, tool discovery and inspector reads are owned and waited for but not listed. Before capturing, gui.cjs runs the recorder probes in evidence/tools/probes.cjs (recorder_probes); each makes the recorder stop with its exact expected message.
